notes: Improved: the Filters sheet no longer opens as one long wall of chips. Category, Language, State and the new Sort by are each a collapsible section now, exactly like the Sound Zone screen - so all of them fit on screen at once, one opens at a time, and reaching State no longer means scrolling past every Category and Language chip first; with a screen reader that difference is around seventy swipes. Each section says what it is set to without being opened ("Language - Hindi, Gujarati", "State - Kerala"), so checking what is filtered needs no expanding at all. The sheet used to open at half height, where a swipe down over the chips was as likely to close it as scroll it; it opens at the height it actually needs now. It also has a Done button - it deliberately stays open while you make several choices, but until now the only ways out were a swipe down or a tap on the dimmed area behind it, which with a screen reader isn't something you can reach at all. New: Sort by - choose how Radio and TV lists come back: Recommended (what the app has always done), Name (A-Z), Most popular, or Highest quality, from the Filters sheet on either screen or from Settings under FILTERS; Recommended is unchanged, so nothing moves unless you ask it to. New: Surprise me - a shuffle button above the list that plays one station picked at random from whatever your filters left on screen, not from the whole catalogue, so it's a quick way to start listening without reading a list; it appears once the list has at least two entries and can be turned off in Settings under RADIO.
